name: Frances Gregg
bio: American avant-garde writer, for a time H.D.'s lover, who married Louis Wilkinson in April 1912 inside a triangle with John Cowper Powys - Powys being in love with her and unwilling to divorce his own wife. She and Wilkinson had a son and a daughter and divorced in 1923. She was killed with her mother and her daughter Betty in the Plymouth blitz of April 1941. Her memoir The Mystic Leeway was published in 1995.
bio_note: Eliot letter of 9 February 1929; Ann Reid to Wilkinson's own Seven Friends (1953) dedication and to Friedman (2002), with her 1932 death to Elwin (1946), p. 207; Diana Bryn to Who Was Who; Joan Lamburn to his Times obituary.
